data.body: **[P1] Preserve the previous observation window before passing.** With the pre-wait removed, an initially passing snapshot returns at 10 seconds; previously validation queried from 10 through 20 seconds. A forbidden, duplicate, or out-of-order event becoming visible at 15 seconds is therefore missed, producing a false conformance pass, and increasing `--log-poll-timeout` does not help. At minimum retain the former 20-second observation floor, or make the settle window configurable/tied to the requested timeout, and add a regression test with a violation arriving after 10 seconds.
